newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Oct bank credit rises 16.2 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Oct bank credit rises 16.2 pct on year.

text.p: Bank credit to non-bank customers (in billions of Singapore dollars):

The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) said in its monthly report that bank credit expanded at a slightly slower rate of 16.2 percent year-on-year in October, compared with 16.4 percent in September.
There was a broad-based slowdown as loans growth in the manufacturing and building and construction sectors fell to 10.8 percent and 21.2 percent, from 12.5 percent and 22.7 percent respectively.
The slowdown was partly offset by stronger growth in credit extended to financial institutions, which rose two percentage points to 15 percent in October.
A slowdown in finance companies' credit growth continued.
Total loans and advances of finance companies rose a mere 0.2 percent in October against 1.4 percent in September.
Growth of housing loans eased to 22 percent in October from 23 percent in September.
